_note: Perf-board footprints for tools/perfboard.html and scripts/check_boards.py. Units = holes on the 0.1 in (2.54 mm) grid. pins: [name, d_row, d_col] at rot 0; rot turns clockwise about the anchor (pin 1). body: drawing only, [x0, y0, x1, y1] in holes (x = col, y = row) at rot 0. Pin spacing is SOURCED from the part datasheets / the item spec: TO-220 0.1 in, axial 0.4 in, screw terminal 5.08 mm (= 2 holes).

TO220.desc: TO-220 standing, G-D-S at 0.1 in (IRLB8721PbF datasheet p.1)

AXIAL400.desc: Axial lead, 0.4 in (10.16 mm) pitch: 1/4 W resistor or 1N4007

TB2_508.desc: Screw terminal block, 2 pos, 5.08 mm pitch

TB3_508.desc: Screw terminal block, 3 pos, 5.08 mm pitch

TB4_508.desc: Screw terminal block, 4 pos, 5.08 mm pitch
